component.name: Boot Bitch
component.summary: Inspect Linux systems and repair boot configuration

description.p: Boot Bitch diagnoses Linux boot environments and performs guarded maintenance of the explicitly selected running host or recovery operations on a selected repair system. It supports encrypted LUKS volumes, Btrfs subvolumes, GRUB, initramfs, EFI/UKI boot paths and graphical login configuration.
Changes require confirmation and are recorded. Read-only diagnostics are available for both scopes before repair actions are run.

description.p: Alpine backend, multi-format packaging and release-tooling release:

ul.li: Alpine/apk repair backend: simulation-first apk fix and apk upgrade transactions, targeted missing-package-file repair, mkinitfs initramfs rebuilds, config-only extlinux regeneration and OpenRC display-manager restore, gated by the new extlinux capability key.
Native RPM and Alpine packaging: package-rpm.sh with test-rpm.sh, and package-alpine.sh with test-apk.sh, build and validate artifacts without installing them.

Release tooling: prepare-release.sh and verify-release.sh keep every per-version release note scoped and every README refinements section permanent, and local-refresh.sh syncs the staging mirror without committing or pushing.
Alpine VM validation: provision the QEMU guest agent once in the guest and local-refresh.sh --alpine-vm builds the signed package in the guest.
Authorization failures surface the real pkexec/Polkit cause instead of only the generic cancellation text.

description.p: Repair-engine, boot-stack and app-store packaging release:

ul.li: Read-only-first file system repair tool and Full Repair stage for the root, /boot, ESP and /home filesystems, with confirmed per-device repair modes after issues are found.
Evidence-driven scoped diagnostics regeneration: unchanged repairs keep the cache valid, changed repairs refresh only the affected sections, and a Full Repair plan regenerates once at the end.
Colored, action-accurate repair result summaries (successful, failed, no repair needed) with a per-stage Full Repair aggregate.
Boot-stack and EFI fixes: conventional GRUB repair no longer corrupts the captured firmware ID when host and repair ESPs share labels, and a failed plan marks only the failing stage.

App-store packaging: portable bundled icon atlas with the Qt SVG runtime dependency, filesystem check tool dependencies, and installed AppStream metadata with screenshots for GNOME Software and KDE Discover.

description.p: Cumulative release with guarded host maintenance, repair-system folder browsing, verified EFI labels, per-drive destination grouping and boot-chain diagnostics.
Fix the repaired-system folder browser layout and show target directories through a compact, resizable read-only dialog.
Add guarded running-host maintenance, host EFI/UKI restoration, model-aware firmware labels, and target-aware repair file browsing.
Add native Qt icon fallbacks and bundled icon search paths for portable AppImage launches.
Add developer attribution, Qt-bundled AppImage packaging, and stronger GNOME/GTK icon and table rendering.
Improve GNOME dark-theme icon contrast and keep table rows compact across platform styles.
Optional GNOME and GTK Qt platform-theme integration and cross-desktop documentation.
Maintenance release with CI compatibility fixes and more robust source-tree helper launching.
First official Boot Bitch release with guarded diagnostics, repair workflows, and support for configured graphical login managers.
